{"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=formal+frameworks+for+distinguishing+between+intrinsic+curiosity-driven+discovery+and+goal-directed+optimization+behavior+in+autonomous+systems&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.1016/0921-8890(92)90030-3\", \"title\": [\"Towards formal theories of autonomous goal-directed behavior\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1016/0921-8890(92)90030-3\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[1992, 1]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1016/j.cogsys.2025.101339\", \"title\": [\"Active exploration and working memory synaptic plasticity shapes goal-directed behavior in curiosity-driven learning\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cogsys.2025.101339\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2025, 6]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.20944/preprints202607.0905.v1\", \"title\": [\"Beyond Human-Designed Objectives: Autonomous Goal Generation in AI Through Intrinsic Motivation and Self-Directed Agency\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>Current artificial intelligence systems remain fundamentally constrained by their dependence on human-designed objectives and reward functions, limiting their capacity for genuine autonomy and open-ended development. This paper proposes Autonomous Goal Generation Networks (AGGNs), a theoretical framework for architectures that synthesize, evaluate, and pursue their own objectives through intrinsic motivation. The framework specifies five components: Goal-Generative Networks (GGNs, based on a VAE-style sampler over a goal embedding space), Objective Evaluation Systems (OESs) with six explicit criteria, Intrinsic Motivation Engines (IMEs) implementing curiosity, competence, empowerment, autonomy, and aesthetic drives, Autonomous Agency Controllers (AACs) for concurrent-objective scheduling, and Self-Reflective Goal Refinement (SRGR) for closing the loop. We prove a goal-distribution convergence result (Theorem 1) under stationary feedback and a stability condition for the SRGR loop. The contribution of this paper is theoretical: we identify the structural and motivational ingredients an autonomously-goal-generating agent must possess. No empirical validation is reported. Section VI specifies the protocol — benchmarks (Minecraft-like exploration, creative reasoning, robotic skill acquisition, scientific discovery, multi-agent social tasks), baselines (curiosity-driven exploration, empowerment maximization, novelty search), and metrics (goal diversity, coherence, achievement rate, exploration efficiency) — against which AGGNs should be evaluated.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.20944/preprints202607.0905.v1\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026, 7, 14]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.25006/ia.4.s2-a15.3\", \"title\": [\"Concomitant VTA – PFC neural encoding of anxiety-related modulation of goal-directed behavior\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.25006/ia.4.s2-a15.3\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2016, 8, 29]]}}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "8e66e07ae2f9dbe32020c31eb9f64d243924881f4c41bf4805ff9dcf55fb54eb", "verification_required": true, "topic_domain": "unassigned_problem", "evidence_role": "discovery", "host_tier": "discovery", "source_identity": null, "persistent_identifiers": ["doi:10.1016/0921-8890(92)90030-3", "doi:10.1016/j.cogsys.2025.101339", "doi:10.20944/preprints202607.0905.v1", "doi:10.25006/ia.4.s2-a15.3"], "source_candidates": ["https://doi.org/10.1016/0921-8890(92)90030-3", "https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cogsys.2025.101339", "https://doi.org/10.20944/preprints202607.0905.v1", "https://doi.org/10.25006/ia.4.s2-a15.3"], "source_candidate_identities": {}}
